summary: Sample price (offline mode): a dryer repair like this usually runs $120 to $250 with a pro.
service_call: $75 to $100, often waived if you go ahead with the repair
includes: the part (about $10 to $40) plus an hour of labor
red_flags: More than $350 for this, ask why
Replacing the whole heating element when the fuse is the problem
A diagnostic fee on top of the repair price without saying so up front
